component.name: Vinci
component.summary: Unofficial DaVinci Resolve installer for any distribution
Instalador não oficial do DaVinci Resolve para qualquer distribuição

description.p: Vinci installs DaVinci Resolve in an isolated Ubuntu container with direct access to your GPU, so it works the same on any Linux distribution without changing your system libraries. It checks your hardware first, finds the official installer you downloaded from Blackmagic Design, creates the menu entry, and helps with the video and audio formats Resolve can't open on Linux.

Vinci is an unofficial project and is not affiliated with Blackmagic Design. DaVinci Resolve is a trademark of Blackmagic Design Pty Ltd. Vinci does not include or redistribute DaVinci Resolve, and collects no data.

O Vinci instala o DaVinci Resolve num container Ubuntu isolado com acesso direto à sua GPU, então ele funciona igual em qualquer distribuição Linux sem mexer nas bibliotecas do sistema. Ele verifica o hardware, encontra o instalador oficial baixado do site da Blackmagic Design, cria o atalho no menu e ajuda com os formatos de vídeo e áudio que o Resolve não abre no Linux.

O Vinci é um projeto não oficial, sem afiliação com a Blackmagic Design. DaVinci Resolve é marca registrada da Blackmagic Design Pty Ltd. O Vinci não inclui nem redistribui o DaVinci Resolve e não coleta nenhum dado.
The tray icon shows whenever Vinci is open, and the container terminal opens in its own Konsole window.
Sound in DaVinci Resolve, the tray icon on KDE and Cinnamon, the container terminal opening in front of Vinci, and GPU decoding when converting media for import.

Free and Studio installed side by side and managed from the home page, a status icon and stop button for each container, the Diolinux MPEG-4 conversion preset, only Resolve itself in the applications menu (Blackmagic's utility shortcuts are removed), and a terminal button that works on more desktops or shows the command to run.

Cancel an installation and remove what it created, optional local activity log, newer Intel GPU drivers, hardware video drivers for AMD and Intel, automatic fallback to the CPU when a GPU encoder fails, and an update action for containers made by older versions.

Progress bar while installing podman and distrobox, About dialog, terminal in the container, button to show converted files, size warnings for conversion presets, window buttons on every desktop and the app icon in the taskbar.
